annotations.title: Read the tool permissions of an integration

description:
Read the tool permissions of an integration

Returns which tools the agents of the account may use through this integration: the stored choice in `preset`, every tool of the integration with `allowed`, and how many tools each preset would allow. The permissions limit agents only; the account owner keeps full access through the dashboard and the calendar endpoints. Only Genesys Cloud and the integration types connected through the dashboard sign-in have tool permissions; every other type answers 404, with the same status used for an integration that does not exist or belongs to someone else. `preset` is `legacy` while nothing was chosen: agents then keep the tools they had before permissions existed. A Genesys Cloud integration never reports `legacy`: without a stored choice it reports `read`, which allows only the tools that read. Handing a conversation over to a person is always allowed and is not listed in `tools`.

id.description: Identifier of the integration. A non-numeric value is rejected with 400.
